outcome: Rate of preeclampsia with severe features
Rate of composite severe neonatal outcomes
cohort: 83,661 women who delivered at ≥22 weeks of gestation in a single tertiary center between January 2011 and December 2018, including 593 women aged 45-49 years and 64 women aged ≥50 years
finding: Healthy women ≥50 years old have higher elective cesarean delivery rates, despite similar maternal and neonatal characteristics compared to women aged 45-49 years.
mod_finding: Elective cesarean deliveries were independently associated with advanced maternal age ≥50 (OR 2.63 95% CI 1.21-5.69).
